acquisition: Registry JSON downloaded directly; no CLI overwrite
sourceRevisionSemantics: sourceRevision with sourceRevisionKind=reproducible-content identifies upstream source whose official registry pipeline reproduces the frozen JSON byte for byte. It does not identify the historical website deployment; servedRevision is null when that deployment revision is unknown.

timestampSemantics.addedAt: Git author timestamp of the first commit introducing the local component implementation and source snapshot; not the download time.
timestampSemantics.updatedAt: Git author timestamp of the latest direct change to src/<component>/index.tsx; excludes shared helpers, documentation, tests and metadata-only changes.

button.modifications: Orbis semantic tokens, owned props, public subpaths, React 19 refs, loading semantics and nested-theme portals

dialog.modifications: Orbis semantic tokens, owned props, public subpaths, React 19 refs, loading semantics and nested-theme portals
